name: Schnitt 5.21.1
notes:
# Schnitt 5.21.1

Schnitt 5.21.1 fixes Wave Warp placement in imported Alight projects and makes imported trim keyframes visible again.

## Wave Warp
Alight stores Wave Warp spacing in radians across the layer. Schnitt was converting that value again as if it were degrees, so a wave that should ripple across the layer became an almost uniform offset and shifted the whole layer to the wrong position. Imported waves now keep their intended spacing, ripple and placement.

## Imported keyframes
- Keys outside a trimmed layer's visible range now appear as faint diamonds on the selected timeline row. They remain editable instead of being invisible but still clickable.
- The easing graph stays available before the first key and after the last key, so animated imported properties no longer report that no keyframes exist.
- Easing stays on the ending key, matching Alight's incoming-curve behaviour.

Projects imported with 5.20 or 5.21.0 do not need to be imported again. Opening them in 5.21.1 applies the corrected Wave Warp spacing automatically.

## Downloads

- `app-arm64-v8a.apk` and `app-armeabi-v7a.apk` need Android 13 or newer.
- `app-compatible-arm64-v8a.apk` and `app-compatible-armeabi-v7a.apk` work on Android 7.0 and newer.
- `app-universal.apk` contains every supported 64-bit and 32-bit library for Android 13 or newer.

All APKs are signed with the same release certificate as 5.21.0.
